features: Explosion-proof, certification by SKU suffix: -C: cLC CSA (Ex d IIC T4, CAN CSA-C22.2 No.60079-0/-1, cert 11396-1S-CSA)
Electro-polished 316L stainless steel on all welded assemblies, A4 stainless fixings, toughened-glass window, 316L mirror-finish sun shield
150 dB WDR, HLC, BLC, SSDR, SSNR, gyro DIS, defog
Analytics: tampering, loitering, directional/virtual line, fog, enter/exit, appear/disappear, face, motion, shock detection
ONVIF Profile S/G/T, SUNAPI 2.0, Wisenet Open Platform
weight up to 21 kg depending on configuration
release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision family datasheet (DataSheet_TNO-X6320E2F2T2-C_20260901_EN.pdf) covering TNO-X6320E2F2* (110VAC, integrated fiber, optional wiper on W models; T1/T2 temperature ratings). Weight is the stated 'up to' maximum. The family sheet's model-number legend marks the F2 fiber option as 'only with wiper option', yet this non-wiper SKU is listed on hanwhavision.com. Weight is given only as a maximum (up to 21 kg), so weight_g is not recorded.

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.
